:::{#exm-surprisal-rarity-four}
#### Surprisal and rarity of an outcome with probability one quarter

Take an outcome with [probability](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#def-probability) $1/4$:

```{r}
#| label: surprisal-rarity-four
p_four <- 1 / 4
rarity_four <- 1 / p_four
surprisal_four <- log2(rarity_four)
surprisal_four
```

By @thm-surprisal-log-rarity, it has rarity $`r rarity_four`$ and a surprisal of $`r surprisal_four`$ [bits](#def-bit).

<!-- no-figure: a single closed-form value -->
